scope: Original consumed validation cohorts only; no new model fit or final scoring
reference_selection: Native reference selected by original mean strict recall key, then mean FPR and AP; no new reference tuning

sources.kind: real anonymized Bitcoin transactions, known-label subset only
synthetic card transactions generated with Sparkov
synthetic, generated from anonymized real application data

limitations: Validation selects prefixes and thresholds and has informed model redesign. No independent confirmation.
Empirical validation FPR is not a future FPR guarantee. No selection-adjusted or time-dependence-adjusted confidence intervals are inferred from counts.
Aggregate counts cannot reconstruct paired errors, score calibration, ROC-AUC or new threshold choices.
Dataset-specific acceptable recall and precision require an application cost target. No universal accuracy pass threshold is inferred.
